cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Closer on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to repair the relationship while redefining closeness around the boundaries that benefit you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'd love a weekend to patch things up. Separate rooms, though, and no old arguments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The old arguments are why we need the weekend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then let's start with a pleasant afternoon. We can rebuild from there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't fit everything I need to say into an afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send the rest by email. I'll read it when I'm ready, and we can keep the afternoon for us.

mechanism: A authorizes only pleasant in-person contact and reserves unilateral readiness for difficult material, defining repair around A comfort.
confusable: D86 avoids the cause entirely; D95 agrees to a repair arrangement while setting self-benefiting boundaries on how it happens.
comparison: Weekend topics diverted to email differ from a dinner ending at ten despite unresolved feelings.
seedUse: Retain D95-b afternoon limit and asynchronous email control, with B objection directly causing the revised boundary.
